before_mc_split.status: preliminary; MC double accounting must be resolved before performance conclusions
limitations: One run per mode; not representative of 50+ players.
Native run_tick calls are starts, not a dedicated completed-job counter.
Worker SSair times_fired counts 240 for 120 run_tick calls; resume bookkeeping is incompatible.
Source of the worker private-memory increase is not established.
Fire and SM worker comparisons have not been run.

capture_scope: After MC split, before the subsequent DM-effect exception cleanup; no exceptions in the six accepted captures. No performance rerun after the cleanup.

second.error: World atmosphere phase cannot overlap itself

normalized_analysis.method: CPU average from in-window OS samples scaled to full sample_wall_seconds; all-server CPU per completed atmosphere tick is an estimate, not isolated solver CPU or latency
normalized_analysis.worker_split: other_threads = process - main_thread; includes all non-main threads, not an isolated Rust-worker counter

normalized.scope: Whole-server CPU divided by completed atmosphere ticks, not isolated atmosphere CPU or latency
normalized.estimate: Average CPU between in-window OS samples scaled to the full metadata window; boundary samples are missing
